definitions.explanation: Describes a surface that is pleasantly smooth to the touch, like skin after moisturizing or polished wood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すべすべだ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}ると→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すべすべ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you apply this cream, your skin becomes smooth.

examples.japanese: すべすべ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like shirts made of smooth fabric.

notes:
すべすべ is an onomatopoeic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) expressing a pleasant smooth texture. It always carries a positive connotation, describing surfaces that feel good to touch.

USAGE:
すべすべ functions as a na-adjective and can also be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧:
- すべすべな⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ / すべすべ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: smooth skin
- すべすべ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧: smooth fabric (⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ form as modifier)
- すべすべ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel smooth
- すべすべ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become smooth

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
Most often used to describe skin or fabric:
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すべすべ: skin is smooth
- すべすべ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧: smooth feel/texture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦つるつる→つるつる：05175_tsurutsuru⟧: smooth and slippery (can imply difficulty gripping; also used for bald heads)
- ⟦さらさら→さらさら：05255_sarasara⟧: smooth and flowing (like dry hair or fine powder)
- すべすべ focuses specifically on pleasant tactile smoothness
